fixture_name: McGrath Hwy (Rte 28) @ Mystic Ave/Broadway — real US design-stage RSA (MassDOT/HNTB)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Unreliable pedestrian indications at a high-volume urban arterial crossing is a real, substantive safety issue squarely relevant at preliminary design.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim of existing dysfunctional pedestrian signals is backed by the verbatim quote 'Investigate and fix existing dysfunctional pedestrian signals.' from cited EV-US-034.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern distinct from any MUTCD compliance question, consistent with FHWA RSA semantics at preliminary design.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific (intersection, user group), actionable (investigate and repair), and viable within the current design stage, though fix details are left open.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrian exposure and reliance on the displays is the explicit focus, so vulnerable road user impact is fully considered.
